value: germination 60.67 +/- 6.11% in light against 28.40 +/- 6.79% in darkness (t-test p = 0.009); burial depth, which cuts light, lowered germination further
method: seeds in water at 25 C in light (12 h photoperiod, 20 +/- 5 umol m-2 s-1) or in complete darkness (foil-wrapped dishes, counted under a safe lamp); five replicates of 50 seeds
conditions: laboratory trial; oxygen, water level (p = 0.219) and substratum had no significant effect on germination; burial: 50.4% at 0 cm, 32% at 1 cm, 0.8% at 2 cm, none below 3 cm in the Results, whereas the abstract gives 3.20% and 0.80% at 2 and 3 cm (abstract and body disagree; body figures carried); authors attribute the burial effect to a light gradient and call light a key cue for this small-seeded species; storage germination tests used about 25 umol m-2 s-1
